application_rule: Start with base and verify SHA. Apply v2-v4 replacement_operations with expected prior tier/decision and append additions. Then apply v5 priority_operations by exact asset_kind/repo_id with expected_current_tier+decision preconditions; require 132 unique coverage. Sort by forecast_investigation_rank. Never infer approval or auto-download. Then apply v6 efficiency_operations by exact asset_kind/repo_id and assert matching v5 wave/rank/decision for all 132. Resource screening never implies runtime success or download approval.

budget_scenario.warning: Scenario only. Existing v3 reserves 100GB for eleven unfinalized items; v4 adds both new repositories' full file sums, not selected file totals or other dependents. Real HDD headroom and cache/staging not measured.
